name: keyart
prompt: EDIT THIS KEY ART: keep the composition (cream paper library tower, bookshelf stairs, small sage-caped card explorer looking up, exactly 3 friendly creatures on upper floors) but completely replace its painterly rendering with TRUE LOW-RESOLUTION PIXEL ART. Use an intentionally tiny 320x180 logical canvas, with each logical pixel enlarged into a visibly large square, a limited 12-color palette of cream, ink, lavender, sage, gold. Every edge must stair-step in chunky blocks. Every surface is an UNIFORM FLAT SOLID COLOR, zero gradients, zero shading transitions, zero watercolor texture, no blur, no smooth brushwork, no dithering. Remove small detail instead of approximating it with tiny pixels. Thick dark-ink pixel outlines. Change the explorer to NO HAT: short sage cape and cream clothes, simple gender-neutral face, blank card, small pouch. Round off drought creature ears so they are folded paper ears rather than horns. Make the upper right boss's cloak lavender, cream face, small folded gold crown; circle, square and triangle windows. Keep hollow flower ring center empty. All book spines and cards blank, no marks or text. Cozy original game background, no violence, weapons, typography, labels, numbers or existing game imagery. Wide 16:9. The result should look like an authentic tiny pixel game background enlarged 5 or 6 times, not a detailed illustration.

name: reader
prompt: ONE production-style pixel sprite concept sheet, four frames in ONE horizontal row, evenly spaced, each frame based on a tiny 32x32 pixel grid, enlarged with nearest-neighbor so pixels are LARGE, square, unmistakable. This must look like a hand-placed 32-pixel videogame sprite, NOT an illustration rendered with small jagged edges. Use ONLY FOUR opaque flat colors: outline #2f2a3d, sage #6faa76, cream #fffaf0, gold #a8741a. Background: true transparent alpha; absolutely no checkerboard, white matte, scenery, platform, text, grid lines, labels or frame borders. Character: small gender-neutral unnamed explorer for ages 10-12; short sage cape, simple cream tunic and trousers, small blank-card pouch, no hat, no facial gender markers, no weapon. Right-facing three-quarter full-body silhouette consistent across all 4 frames, with simple dark eye pixel and rounded proportions. Frames left to right: 1) standing idle, blank card held near chest. 2) defense, spreading several blank cards into a small fan, feet stable. 3) question attack, pointing with an empty hand toward the right at an implied sentence, other hand holds blank card; no physical strike or projectile. 4) defeat, knee bent, head gently lowered, blank cards placed near feet, no injury. Identical character identity, head size, palette, baseline, and frame scale. Keep every body, hand, cape, and card inside its separate cell. No lettering on the blank cards. Leave clear transparent gutters between the four poses. Crisp 1-logical-pixel outline, a few big solid blocks, no extra shading colors, no antialiasing, no blur, no gradient, no glossy lighting. Horizontal sheet. Original character, no recognizable existing game or commercial sprite reference.

name: drought
prompt: ONE horizontal transparent pixel sprite sheet, FIVE evenly separated frames in one row, no lettering, labels, backgrounds, grid lines, shadows or checkerboard. Original friendly drought paper creature for a children's literacy game, facing LEFT. Base grid each frame 32x32 pixels, highly enlarged hard square blocks, absolutely chunky low-resolution hand-placed pixel art. ONLY ink #2f2a3d plus THREE body colors: cream #fffaf0, lavender #7a7393, gold #a8741a; all opaque flat fills, no gradients, shading colors, antialiasing, blur, noise, painterly texture. Creature is a low wide ROUND EARTH LUMP, very short two feet, two rounded folded-paper ears, small gold eyes, ONE central irregular crack in body. NO horns, teeth, weapons or scary expression. Frame 1 idle. Frame 2 sends a friendly dust RING leftward; ring stays in cell. Frame 3 first sealing stage, body folds like paper along its central crack. Frame 4 second sealing stage, body becomes a smaller folded cream paper rectangle. Frame 5 final sealing, tiny folded paper creature enters a gold BOOKMARK; no separate aggressive opponent. Consistent silhouette, palette and baseline across first two frames; progressively smaller but centered in sealing frames. Each frame contained, wide transparent gutters. Match a cozy cream-paper pixel UI with sage/lavender/gold. True transparent alpha background. No words, numerals or any recognizable existing game assets.

name: bloomgap
prompt: ONE horizontal sprite concept sheet with FIVE evenly separated frames, all on true transparent alpha. A tiny original hollow flower-ring paper creature facing LEFT for a cozy Korean children's literacy game. Hand-placed 32x32 pixel grid per frame enlarged into chunky sharp square pixels. Use ONLY ink outline #2f2a3d and THREE flat body colors: sage #6faa76, cream #fffaf0, lavender #7a7393. No shading colors, gradients, antialiasing, blur, glow or texture. The silhouette is a rounded scalloped SAGE FLOWER RING with a clearly open circular center; the center MUST BE COMPLETELY TRANSPARENT, NOT dark paint. A small cream fog tail hangs below the ring. Two short curled cream PAPER RIBBONS hang as arms, not weapons. Two small lavender eyes sit on the lower outer ring, not floating in the empty hole. Friendly and oddly cute; no scary face, teeth, horns, leaves, real bee or wings. Frames left to right: idle; attack by gently curving its two paper ribbons outward without contact; sealing stage 1 flower ring folds vertically like paper; sealing stage 2 becomes a small folded cream slip; sealing stage 3 the slip tucks into a simple sage bookmark with ink outline. Keep the first two character sizes and baselines identical. Sealing becomes progressively smaller. Keep each frame within its cell, with transparent gutters. No scenery, floor, shadows, checkerboard, white matte, grid lines, labels, letters, numbers, words, title or existing game visual designs. Wide horizontal composition, simple large readable blocks.

name: erasure
prompt: ONE transparent horizontal sheet containing FIVE separate enlarged tiny 48x48 pixel sprites in one row, evenly spaced with transparent gutters. An original friendly paper-fog king for ages 10-12, facing LEFT. Strong top-wide, bottom-narrow CLOAK silhouette; rounded small hands, very short feet. ONLY FOUR flat opaque colors total: ink outline #2f2a3d, lavender cloak #7a7393, cream face #fffaf0, gold folded-paper crown #a8741a. No additional shades, gradients, antialiasing, glow, blur or texture. True coarse hand-placed pixel art, obvious square clusters on a 48x48 logical grid, not a smooth cartoon with jagged edges. Exactly THREE distinct small OPEN WINDOWS in cloak: a circle, a square, a triangle, visibly different even at small size; transparent holes outlined in ink. Simple cream face under crown with tiny ink eyes, friendly odd expression, no teeth, horns, weapons, angry attack, blood or injuries. Frames left to right: idle; attack by gently spreading broad cloak without touching anyone; sealing stage 1 broad cloak folds inward; sealing stage 2 small folded lavender paper slip; sealing stage 3 slip tucks into a simple gold bookmark. First two frames consistent scale, crown and body identity; sealing shrinks progressively. Entire crown, hands and cloak stay in each cell. TRUE transparent background, no checkerboard, painted transparency grid, scenery, floor shadow, UI, words, lettering, numbers, labels, captions or framing boxes. Wide horizontal sheet. Cohesive cream-paper, sage/lavender/gold children's literacy game aesthetic, no recognizable existing game designs.

name: cards
prompt: ONE sheet of SIX ORIGINAL EMPTY horizontal note-card frames for a children's pixel literacy game. True transparent background outside the six frames, no checkerboard. Arrange as 2 columns by 3 rows, six IDENTICAL SIZE wide horizontal rectangles, width:height ratio 104:56, large transparent gutters. They look like simple library paper slips with a tiny folded corner, NOT ornate fantasy playing cards, not portrait cards. Hand-placed coarse pixel art, crisp square clusters, ink #2f2a3d 1-logical-pixel outlines, warm cream #fffaf0 interiors, only 2-3 flat fill colors per frame, no gradients, blur, glow, textures, antialiasing, shadows behind objects or metallic sheen. Row-major order: first three question frames have restrained gold bottom tabs; fourth fog frame has lavender bottom tab; fifth seal frame has two tiny gold paper-fold lines at bottom; sixth word/defense frame has blue bottom tab. Keep same geometry for all six. Reserve an EMPTY small icon area at upper LEFT and an EMPTY cost area at upper RIGHT, leave both areas BLANK without symbols, digits or mock lettering. Large blank central area for HTML text later. No words, characters, runes, numerals, question marks, illustrations, weapons, crowns, suits, cost gems or existing game card motifs. Pure simple pixel paper note frames only. Clear edges designed to be scalable by CSS nine-slice.

name: icons
prompt: ONE sheet of 12 tiny pixel UI icons arranged in a clean 4-column by 3-row grid, equally spaced, each drawn on an exact 16x16 logical grid and greatly enlarged into obvious square blocks. True TRANSPARENT alpha background around every icon, no baked checkerboard, no painted grid, no panels, no labels, no numbers, no lettering or words. Crisp one-logical-pixel ink #2f2a3d outline, only one additional flat role color per icon, no antialiasing, gradients, highlights, blur, glow, texture or shading. Read left-to-right then next row: 1 thinking power: simple faceted gold gem. 2 attack DAMAGE: compact red impact star, no sword or weapon. 3 defense: blue shield with simple interior check. 4 fog shield: lavender rounded cloud with short horizontal lines. 5 evidence sentence: cream paper with three horizontal ink lines, no letters. 6 clue: gold magnifying glass over small paper corner. 7 sure confidence: ink circle with check, gold accent. 8 unsure confidence: ink diamond with a small central dot, lavender accent; NO question mark. 9 seal: gold bookmark with a V-notch. 10 hit: two linked gold light segments. 11 weak hit: one short amber segment and one hollow segment. 12 failure: folded closed lavender paper slip with small X. Cheerful original coherent icon language for a Korean children's reading game, strong silhouettes that distinguish roles without color. Transparent gutters, no shadows, no decorative objects, no extra icons. Wide enough to show all 12 clearly.
